mapper.update: INSERT INTO embeddings (source_type, source_id, novel_id, chapter_no, content, embedding) VALUES (#{sourceType}, #{sourceId}, #{novelId}, #{chapterNo}, #{content}, #{vecStr}::vector) ON CONFLICT (source_type, source_id) WHERE is_deleted = FALSE DO UPDATE SET embedding = EXCLUDED.embedding, content = EXCLUDED.content, chapter_no = EXCLUDED.chapter_no, update_time = NOW()
mapper.select: SELECT source_type AS "sourceType", source_id AS "sourceId", chapter_no AS "chapterNo", content, embedding <=> #{vecStr}::vector AS distance FROM embeddings WHERE novel_id = #{novelId} AND is_deleted = FALSE ORDER BY embedding <=> #{vecStr}::vector LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT d.id AS "sourceId", c.chapter_no AS "chapterNo", d.content_md AS content FROM digests d JOIN chapters c ON c.id = d.chapter_id WHERE c.novel_id = #{novelId} AND d.is_deleted = FALSE AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM embeddings e WHERE e.source_type = 'digest' AND e.source_id = d.id AND e.is_deleted = FALSE) ORDER BY c.chapter_no DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT id AS "sourceId", kind, name FROM material_cards WHERE novel_id = #{novelId} AND is_deleted = FALSE AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM embeddings e WHERE e.source_type = 'card' AND e.source_id = material_cards.id AND e.is_deleted = FALSE) ORDER BY id LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT count(*) FROM embeddings WHERE novel_id = #{novelId} AND is_deleted = FALSE
